title: 统一评分器：特征、划分及训练协议
publication_note: Curated and path-redacted snapshot. Source hash refers to the original local artifact.

content.name: Unified four-module supervised hand-quality classifier
content.authorization: User explicitly requests a single scorer combining all existing modules to judge good/bad.

features.training_view: RGB; existing grayscale/JPEG candidate outputs only for fixed stress evaluation
features.handcraft_inference: Official frozen YOLO640 conf.25 iou.7; batch full+square ROIs per image, rectFalse; verify old cached features16probes under2e-5 before reuse.

content.labels: Existing human selected repair=positive; reject-both completed repairs=negative. Unchosen alternative and original only pairwise, never absolute negatives.
content.split: Original dev unchanged. Sort748 original train prompt groups by SHA256(unified-cal-20261105:+group); first floor748/5=149 groups internal calibration, other599 fit. No image/group overlap; original protected tests unread.
content.fit: Three893->64GELU->1 heads, same seed20261105, fixed20epochs RGB only; AdamW lr.001 wd.01 batch128 clip1. BCE explicit labels + softplus pairwise preferred>Bad and preferred>alternate + .001 logit square. Balanced method/label/prompt weights. Frozen modules and no generator updates.
content.calibration: Positive-slope Platt with .001 parameter L2; held-out calibration method/label/prompt-balanced BCE only. Select threshold on calibration method- and class-equal balanced accuracy; ties closest50. Never tune using dev or candidate scores.
content.delivery: Deploy all_modules as requested experimental single score with predicted good/bad and calibration threshold; also report both controls and dev error counts even if fusion does not improve. No automatic further tuning or generator training.
content.limitations: Human adoption is not certified anatomy. Learned module failures and source bias can persist. Score is calibrated to balanced human acceptability; no independent anatomy or new Sana candidate human ground truth.
